walkthrough: Goal: texture (纹理, unit 7): telling a surface's texture by the shadows its small forms throw (implicit), not by outlining every form (explicit); at level 3 letting the side toward the light go sparse (Drawabox's texture analysis). The shadows missed and the marks over light are read directly from the generated scene, but what to leave out is mine, so they are marks and my eye judges (D123).

Entry: unit 7's tile Texture (after colour under light), or Start when it is next; no pack is needed. A lesson holds one strip, about 5 minutes, the sun from the left and the right in turn: level 1 round pebbles of one size; level 2 plates lying tilted, ridges and grooves, a few pebbles; level 3 a dense mix, the half toward the light kept to its biggest shadows.

How, first time: Texture by its shadows; a surface's texture told by the shadows its small forms throw. The example strip in the left frame: 1 a pebble's outline drawn in pencil and crossed out; 2 the shadow it throws filled with Darkest; 3 every other shadow, nearest first (level 3: 4 toward the light only the biggest); Compare: the shadows faint over the copy, the one the hand left out ringed. One paragraph: fill the dark shapes the forms throw, leave the halftones and the lit sides paper.

The exercise: the strip's picture (clay-tinted forms on the ground, lit low from one side, their shadows dark and hard-edged) in the left frame, the copy's frame of its shape, twice as wide as high, blank at the right. The tools: Darkest alone (最黑), Undo, Redo; no line pen, no fill.
Darkest: I fill most shadows nearest first, two strokes each; leave the three at the right out (one cut by the frame); and draw an outline round one pebble (a mistake: an outline is no shadow).

Compare: the answer's shadows laid over my copy at the slider; each shadow I left out ringed, the part of my outline lying where the light falls outlined red. The card: Texture 1, Original shown; then Accurate, Almost, Again for me to choose. No count line, no app result.
Slid to the end, the answer's shadows show whole. I choose Again; it is kept. Finish: the lesson's end.
Level 2: plates, ridges and grooves; level 3: the dense mix, its How's step toward the light.
Reopen: Home leaves the level 3 lesson under way; Continue reopens it.
